description: Visits follow a three-phase lifecycle: Plan, Engage, Report. Planning involves scheduling, reviewing account summaries, confirming objectives, and preparing materials/samples/presentations. Engagement captures the actual interaction - product detailing, key messages, sample disbursement, signature capture. Reporting updates visit information, adds discussions, captures medical inquiries, expenses, and aligns next steps in the account plan.
setup_steps: Define visit record types for each visit type (In-Person, Phone, Video, Group)
Configure field sets for each visit type to control visible fields
Set up visit page layouts per record type
Configure visit submission validation rules
Enable sample limit validation if samples are disbursed
Configure signature capture requirements per visit channel
Set up metadata cache regeneration after visit configuration changes
gotchas: Record type mismatch is the most common source of field visibility issues
Signature should NOT be required for phone/remote visits
Metadata cache must be regenerated after visit configuration changes
Account filter may not show expected accounts due to territory alignment gaps
A single visit cannot have both Detail and Touchpoint values simultaneously
migration_relevance: Veeva Call2_vod maps to ProviderVisit. Call Detail maps to ProviderVisitProductDetailing. Call Sample maps to sample disbursement records. The three-phase lifecycle is conceptually similar but object names and relationships differ significantly.

description: Visit record types control form layout, available fields, and validation rules. Record type assignment is driven by visit type (In-Person, Remote/Phone, Group) combined with channel. Record types include Detail Call (In-Person), Phone Call (Remote), Video Call (Remote), Group Visit, Medical Visit, and custom types. The channel field is separate from visit type and drives different validation and analytics rules.
setup_steps: Create record types for each visit type (Detail, Phone, Video, Group, Medical)
Assign record types to profiles
Configure page layouts per record type
Map channel picklist values to visit types
Configure field-level security per record type
gotchas: Missing record type assignments cause wrong form layouts
Channel field is SEPARATE from visit type - map legacy call types to BOTH
Field sets not configured for the visit type cause missing fields
migration_relevance: Veeva Call_Type_vod maps to both VisitType and Channel fields. Must map each legacy call type to the correct combination.

description: Group visits use visit attendee junction records to track multiple HCPs in a single visit. Each attendee gets their own detailing, sample, and signature records. The platform supports pre-planned attendees (added during scheduling) and walk-in attendees (added during the visit). Attendee-level analytics aggregate separately from the parent visit. During a lunch-and-learn with three HCPs, the Visit object tracks overall information while ProviderVisitAttendee tracks per-HCP details.
setup_steps: Configure group visit record type
Set up attendee junction object layout
Configure per-attendee detailing and sample records
Set up pre-planned vs walk-in attendee workflows
gotchas: Each attendee needs separate detailing records - a common oversight
Attendee-level analytics aggregate separately from parent visit
migration_relevance: Veeva Group Call maps to group visit with attendee junction records. The junction pattern differs from Veeva flat structure.

description: The visit planner provides calendar views (day, week, month). Visits can be created by selecting a time slot and account. The planner integrates with territory alignment to show only accessible accounts. Filter options include account type, visit status, and territory. Suggested visits from Next Best Customer recommendations appear in the planner. Routines enable reps to save reusable visit schedules for recurring weekly routes or multi-day loops.
setup_steps: Configure visit planner calendar views
Set up territory alignment for account filtering
Enable Next Best Customer recommendations in planner
Configure routine templates for recurring schedules
gotchas: Account filter depends on territory alignment - misalignment hides accounts
Routines are the correct feature for reusable visit schedules, not custom objects
migration_relevance: Veeva Scheduler maps to visit planner. Route plans map to Routines feature.

description: Visit submission triggers a validation chain: (1) Required field checks, (2) Sample limit validation if samples are disbursed, (3) Signature capture if required by configuration, (4) Offline queue if no connectivity. Upon submission, ProviderVisitProductDetailing, sample transaction, and signature records are created as child records. Visit status changes to Submitted/Completed.
setup_steps: Configure required fields per visit record type
Set up sample limit validation rules
Configure signature requirements per channel type
Set up offline queue behavior
gotchas: Sample limit blocking visits when limits are not fully configured
Signature requirements must match visit channel - no signature for phone visits
Offline submission queues if no connectivity - monitor sync after
migration_relevance: Veeva Submit Call maps to visit submission. Validation chain is configurable unlike Veeva hardcoded validation order.

description: Remote Engagement enables virtual interactions via video, voice, and digital channels. Teams can share interactive compliant content, collect information, capture digital signatures, and track activities. Remote visits support screen sharing, activity tracking, and feedback collection. Twilio endpoints must be trusted by the org for video traffic. Email notification templates must be configured for virtual visit invitations.
setup_steps: Add Twilio endpoints to trusted sites in the org
Configure email templates for remote engagement invitations
Set up remote visit record types
Configure screen sharing and content sharing permissions
Enable digital signature capture for remote visits
gotchas: Twilio CSP trusted sites must be configured - video will not work without this
Email notification templates must be configured or invitations will not send
GDPR privacy requirements apply to remote engagement recordings
migration_relevance: Veeva Engage maps to Remote Engagement. Twilio is the video provider. Configuration is significantly different.

description: Homepage supports multiple visit-related widgets: Top 10 Next Best Customers (AI-driven recommendations), Up Next (upcoming scheduled visits), Activity Plan attainment dashboard, and custom dashboards. Quick actions from homepage can launch visit creation, insights review, email composition, and inquiry submission. Widget configuration is per-persona (sales vs medical users may see different widgets).
setup_steps: Configure homepage layouts per persona (sales vs medical)
Enable Next Best Customer component
Configure Up Next widget settings
Set up Activity Plan attainment dashboard
Configure quick actions for visit creation
gotchas: Next Best Customer requires geolocation data on account address for distance-based sorting
Standard dashboards may not render correctly on mobile - this is a known platform limitation
Widget configuration is per-persona, not global
migration_relevance: Maps to Veeva homepage widgets but with significantly more configuration options and AI-driven recommendations.

description: MedTech visits differ from pharma visits. They support surgical case visits, inventory cycle counts, product-related activities, and blind cycle counts. Work Types define visit behavior. Visitors represent the sales rep, Visited Party represents the surgeon/contact. Action Plans provide structured task templates for visits. Assessment Tasks must be completed in sequence defined by Assessment Task Order.
setup_steps: Define Work Types for each visit category (Surgical Case, Cycle Count, etc.)
Create Action Plan Templates for standardized visit workflows
Configure Assessment Task sequences
Set up Visitor and Visited Party relationships
gotchas: MedTech uses different visit objects than pharma Customer Engagement
Work Type determines available business behavior - must be set correctly
Assessment Task Order must be defined for proper sequence
migration_relevance: MedTech visit patterns are unique to the platform - no direct Veeva equivalent for surgical case management.
